error.invalid_feed: The URL did not return a valid GTFS feed. A GTFS feed is a zip file containing agency.txt, routes.txt, stop_times.txt, stops.txt, trips.txt, and calendar.txt or calendar_dates.txt. Check the logs for details.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https URL.

progress.load_feed: Downloading and importing the GTFS feed. Large feeds can take several minutes.

reconfigure.description: Download the feed again to pick up a new timetable, optionally from a new URL. Your routes are kept.

data_description.url: Direct link to the agency's static GTFS zip file.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The feed must finish loading before routes can be added.

error.same_stop: Origin and destination must be different stops.

cannot_connect.message: Could not download the GTFS feed. Check the feed URL and your network connection.

invalid_feed.message: The downloaded file is not a valid GTFS feed: {error}

feed_expired.description: The GTFS feed {title} has no service after {last_date}, so its route calendars stay empty. If the agency has published a new timetable, reconfigure the feed to download it again, entering a new URL if it has moved.
feed_expired.title: GTFS feed {title} has expired
